description: pSEO taxonomy vertical context files for mediaplanningtool.com. Each file provides deep niche context for generating genuinely useful media planning pages.

verticals.name: Automotive
verticals.description: OEM, dealer, and tier 1/2/3 automotive advertising — covers co-op complexity, dealer paid search conflict, CTV growth, EV-specific strategy

verticals.name: CPG / FMCG
verticals.description: Consumer packaged goods — covers retail media network fragmentation, shopper marketing integration, RMN measurement, and trade/media budget dynamics

verticals.name: Financial Services
verticals.description: Banking, insurance, wealth management — covers compliance constraints, special ad categories, CPL quality vs. volume, and TCPA changes

verticals.name: Healthcare / Pharma
verticals.description: DTC, HCP, and device advertising — covers FDA OPDP compliance, HCP-DTC coordination, rare disease targeting, and NRx measurement lag

verticals.name: Retail / E-Commerce
verticals.description: Omnichannel retail and DTC — covers Amazon Ads ecosystem, RMN strategy, ROAS incrementality, seasonal concentration, and social commerce

verticals.name: Travel & Hospitality
verticals.description: Airlines, hotels, OTAs, and DMOs — covers OTA channel conflict, metasearch optimization, long consideration cycles, and CTV adoption

verticals.name: Technology / SaaS / B2B Tech
verticals.description: Enterprise and mid-market SaaS, B2B tech — covers ABM media strategy, buying committee fragmentation, LinkedIn economics, and dark funnel measurement

verticals.name: Entertainment / Media / Streaming
verticals.description: Streaming services, film studios, gaming, live events — covers audience fragmentation, subscriber CAC/churn dynamics, theatrical P&A, and cross-platform measurement

verticals.name: QSR / Restaurants
verticals.description: Quick service and fast casual restaurants — covers national co-op vs. local franchisee tension, LTO launch strategy, first-party digital ordering shift, and SSS measurement

schema_fields.audience: Primary audience segments for this vertical
schema_fields.pain_points: 4-6 specific media planning pain points unique to this vertical
schema_fields.regulatory: Key regulatory constraints affecting media planning
schema_fields.seasonality: Seasonal patterns that affect budget allocation and timing
schema_fields.budget_dynamics: How budgets are typically structured and shifting
schema_fields.channels_that_work: 5-7 most effective channels for this vertical
schema_fields.typical_budget_range: Typical annual media budget range for mid-market brands
schema_fields.buying_model: How media is typically bought (programmatic, direct, etc.)
schema_fields.creative_considerations: What makes creative work for this vertical
